authorization: User explicitly confirmed P-192 and P-224 and requested higher confidence, wider samples, larger controls, execution and PRs
control_distribution: Globally distinct primes drawn uniformly by odd-integer rejection, same bit length and within +/-1% of S, clipped to that bit interval. C additionally has S mod 12. R is not filtered by residue.
excluded_engineering_probe: instrument-01: eight exact (p,A,B) triples retained with run; not pooled
order_audit: Exact PARI ellcard, partial factor(N,2^20); every small factor and primality flag checked. Unresolved cofactors remain explicitly unresolved; no full largest-factor claim.
small_subgroup_selection: For each ordinary nonsingular curve, smallest certified prime factor ell with 16<=bits(ell)<=20 and multiplicity one, N!=p, j not 0/1728, no embedding degree <=20. Never promoted to the curve's main cryptographic subgroup.
matching: Separately S to R and S to C: maximum cardinality then minimum sum absolute log subgroup-order distance, <=10% order mismatch; a curve used once per contrast. Shared S identities across the two contrasts are retained, not additional independent curves.
rho_small_cap: ceil(20*sqrt(ell)); primary uses min(search group calls/sqrt(ell),20), setup/verification separate
BSGS_small: complete coverage, M=min(4096,ceil(sqrt(ell))); memory retained; expected exact search calls floor(q/M)
large_subgroup_arm: First ordinary curve in each control field with a certified prime partial-factor residual ell of at least 128 bits, multiplicity one and no embedding degree<=20; first 64 eligible distinct S curves per case. One synthetic target, rho16 seed1, fixed 4096 search group-call cap. No BSGS. All non-recoveries censored/inconclusive for full ECDLP. Two NIST coefficient/generator/order anchors additionally checked and bounded.
integrity_controls: First 4 sorted matched S groups per case: all targets/seeds exact sham, replay and inverse-coordinate transport; actual isomorphic endpoint rho; first 4 large S groups/case exact replay and transport. One tiny prime subgroup per case with complete BSGS positive control if present. Kernel instrument checks compare prior toy kernel and PARI at full sizes before sampling.
primary_endpoint: Per-case matched-pair log ratio of mean capped search group calls/sqrt(ell), S/R. Equal weight to each matched random control field after averaging its pairs. Conditional on fixed selection and matching.
secondary_endpoints: S/R and S/C oracle16 and rho32
native rho search wall time with matching/search-work limitations
unconditional order-primality, small-factor eligibility and trace distributions
full-field arithmetic and Python sparse-reduction prototype
binary_population_intervals: All S curves and the first unconditional curve per independent control field give exact Clopper-Pearson rate intervals; two 99.95% intervals give a conservative >=99.9% S-control difference interval. Also retain hits from every control curve as descriptive counts. Normalized trace uses all four control curves per field and field clustering.
arithmetic_interval_scope: 99.9% control-field bootstrap conditional on the fixed S five-batch median; excludes S systematic timing error. The two fixed-field prototype ratios are descriptive and have no population confidence interval.

inference.attack_unit: whole matched control-field cluster, all its frozen pairs/seeds/targets together; matching itself not rerun in bootstrap
inference.population_unit: independent S curves and independent control fields with all their curves together, not 512 independent S fields
inference.interval_type: approximate percentile cluster bootstrap; nominal coverage, not guaranteed exact coverage

decision_policy: Per-case generic small-subgroup practically similar only if its reserved-family primary interval lies fully inside the similarity margin and minimum sample requirements met; materially greater only if lower interval endpoint >1.2; otherwise inconclusive. Large capped null outcomes never prove practical similarity or resistance. All original Solinas observations kept separate.

arithmetic.timing: single CPU after preparation and attack phases; randomized workload/arm order
arithmetic.implementations: same Python built-in arithmetic for S/R/C; explicit signed-fold reductions on S checked exactly against %; prototype timings not optimized native code

stopping: Fixed fields and curve counts; no outcome-based enlargement or seed replacement. At most 50000 prime candidates per field, 20000 generator attempts, 600-second GP chunks, 600-second attack chunks. Infrastructure stops preserved and not mathematical negatives.
claims: Observations only; no independent scientific review, official research-state transition, sealed bound, asymptotic claim or standard-curve security claim
